html: The Tharrkari, also spelt Targari, are an Aboriginal Australian people of the Gascoyne region of Western Australia, in the inland country of the Lyons and upper Minilya rivers. The map shows them as Tharrgari from 1600 to 1815. Little is recorded about them. Their neighbours were the Warriyangga to the east, the Yinggarda to the south and the Baiyungu on the coast to the west. Sheep stations took up this country from the late 1800s.
